moonton_gms_snapshot.note: The endpoint does not expose a verified Original Server patch identifier. Numeric-token comparison is a review lead, not proof by itself.

evidence_policy.patch_notes: Community-maintained mirrors of in-game Original Server notes. No direct official Moonton patch-note URL was verified in this review.
evidence_policy.moonton_gms: Official-client metadata endpoint accessed through a community-documented request. Its response is not independently stamped with an Original Server patch version.
evidence_policy.application: Only patch-note changes with a clear skill/field mapping are classified as confirmed candidates. No canonical hero record is silently overwritten by this report.
